meta.source: reonic.com/en-gb computed styles, 7 Nov 2026 (Geist Sans, zinc neutrals, off-black pill CTAs, amber-to-salmon AI gradient, emerald/rose status)

tokens.name: surface-0
tokens.usage: Page background. Reonic's warm off-white, never pure white.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Cards, panels and inputs sitting on surface-0.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Muted fills: secondary buttons, table header rows, inactive segments, hover.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline borders on cards, inputs and dividers. Borders, not shadows, separate things.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Control outlines that must reach 3:1: input borders on focus-off, checkbox edges.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on surface-0/1/2. Reonic's off-black.

tokens.name: ink-body
tokens.usage: Running text and descriptions on surface-0/1.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: units, captions, metadata, placeholders. 4.5:1 on surface-0 and surface-1.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary action fill (the black pill CTA). One per view.

tokens.name: primary-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus rings (2px, offset 2px). Reonic's sky blue.

tokens.name: ai-amber
tokens.usage: Start of the AI gradient. Fills only: AI-generated moments (the design the engine just made, a live voice call).

tokens.name: ai-orange
tokens.usage: Middle of the AI gradient; solid AI accent fill (live-call pulse, AI badge dot).

tokens.name: ai-salmon
tokens.usage: End of the AI gradient. Fills only.

tokens.name: ai-text
tokens.usage: AI accent as text ("Drafted by AI", the AI badge label) on surface-0/1. 4.9:1 on white.

tokens.name: ai-tint
tokens.usage: Quiet background behind AI-generated content and the AI badge.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Reonic's soft yellow: a secondary call-out fill ("switch" actions, a changed value after a refine). Text on it is ink (light theme) or #1b1d20.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Reonic's sky blue for line accents and data marks, not for text on light grounds.

tokens.name: comp-pv
tokens.usage: Data colour for PV / solar in charts, energy-flow lines and component icons.

tokens.name: comp-battery
tokens.usage: Data colour for battery storage. Darker than sky so it separates from PV by lightness too.

tokens.name: comp-heatpump
tokens.usage: Data colour for heat pump.

tokens.name: comp-wallbox
tokens.usage: Data colour for wallbox / EV charging.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Positive state fill: matches the expert, high confidence, within range.

tokens.name: success-text
tokens.usage: Positive state as text on surface-0/1 or success-tint.

tokens.name: success-tint
tokens.usage: Background for positive badges and the 'matches expert' banner.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Caution fill: medium confidence, unusual size, assumption used.

tokens.name: warning-text
tokens.usage: Caution as text on surface-0/1 or warning-tint.

tokens.name: warning-tint
tokens.usage: Background for caution badges and validation flags.

tokens.name: critical
tokens.usage: Problem fill: outside every similar home, physically implausible, error.

tokens.name: critical-text
tokens.usage: Problem as text on surface-0/1 or critical-tint.

tokens.name: critical-tint
tokens.usage: Background for critical flags.

families.sans: Geist, "Geist Fallback", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.sample: Designed before you reach the van
styles.usage: One hero line per screen. Regular weight, tight tracking, as on reonic.com.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Homes using 4,500 kWh a year with an EV typically got 9 to 11 kWp.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Based on 214 similar homes from this installer.
styles.usage: Dense UI text, table cells, buttons.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels and eyebrows; uppercase allowed.

styles.name: quote
styles.sample: We create quotes quickly and intuitively.
styles.usage: Testimonials and the homeowner's own words only, as on reonic.com.

styles.name: metric
styles.usage: The headline size of a component. Always with its unit.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Numbers in tables and ranges; tabular figures.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside badges and dense rows.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between a label and its value.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page top padding; hero spacing.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, small chips, range bars.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards and panels (Reonic's .625rem).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Large surfaces: the system overview, dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons and badges. Every button is a pill, as on reonic.com.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Optional lift on cards that float over imagery. Default cards use border only.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Popovers, the live-call sheet, dialogs.
